summary: Kayaker re-circulated in a hole above the 23-foot falls on Oh Be Joyful Creek in July; he hit his head, went unresponsive and floated facedown over the falls; his partner pulled him out blue and not breathing and performed CPR for two to five minutes until he breathed on his own; the pair were hiking down the road when SAR arrived; transported to the hospital and released the same day
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE - CBN 2019-08 says only 'in July'. Distinct from the 2024-06-07 Brunner speed-trap incident (id 2304) and the 2011-07-18 Goodnough Old Growth Drop incident (id 2276).
